name: Iitate (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Iitate village emblem in green: an outlined ring crossed by a horizontal bar, enclosing a stylised peak.
history: Municipal flag of Iitate, a village in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Iitate village emblem — an outlined ring crossed by a horizontal bar, enclosing a stylised peak
